title: Import patients
hint: A CSV or XLSX file with a header row. Columns: given name, family name and birth date (for example 31.01.1990), and optionally phone. At most 5000 rows. The patients are added to the clinic without a consent: the front desk records it at their first booking.
ready: {count, plural, one {# patient read} other {# patients read}}. Nothing is saved until you import.
wrong: {count, plural, one {# of {total} rows has errors} other {# of {total} rows have errors}}. Correct them in the file and choose it again.
duplicates: {count, plural, one {# row has the name and birth date of a patient already at the clinic or on an earlier row} other {# rows have the name and birth date of a patient already at the clinic or on an earlier row}}. They are imported all the same: remove them from the file if they are the same people.
duplicateLine: Line {line}: {name}, born {birthDate}, may already be at the clinic
givenNameInvalid: the given name is missing or longer than 100 characters
familyNameInvalid: the family name is missing or longer than 100 characters
birthDateInvalid: the birth date is not a valid date in the past
phoneInvalid: the phone is not a valid number
unreadable: The file could not be read. Use a CSV or XLSX file with a header row naming at least the given name, family name and birth date columns, and at most 5000 rows.
failed: The file could not be imported. Try again.
forbidden: Only the clinic's admin can import patients.
imported: {count, plural, one {# patient imported.} other {# patients imported.}}
